Family Suite

A king-size bed and a single bed: made for a couple travelling with a child.

Request this roomWhatsApp

One bed for the parents, one for the child.

The Family Suite brings a king-size bed and a single bed together in one space, with a television. It is the natural choice for a couple travelling with a child who want to stay close to the beach and the restaurant without booking two rooms.
